annotations.text:
DIRECTION A — Split band
The QR gets its own cream field, so it is dark-on-light and can never fail a scanner. Structured and brand-forward. Tradeoff: the hard vertical split is a strong, committed layout — less "poster", more "card".
Back A keeps the review offer but flips the hierarchy: 15% OFF is the hook, "leave a review" is the instruction. The green strip carries the contact line the old card had nowhere for.

DIRECTION B — Full green
One uninterrupted green field, QR as a soft cream tile bottom-right. Moodier and closer to the original card. Tradeoff: smaller QR (0.59in vs 0.86in) and it sits nearer the trim edge.
Back B is the alternative back if you would rather the card carry contact details than the review offer. Mix and match: any front works with either back.

PRINT SPEC
1050 x 600 px = 3.5 x 2 in at 300 dpi (trim size).
All live copy sits inside a 72 px (0.24 in) safe margin.
Ask the printer for 0.125 in bleed — add 38 px of the background colour on every side when you export, so the green and cream fields run off the edge cleanly.

Type is Montserrat here as a stand-in. Swap to real Gotham for print: Black for the caps line, Bold Italic for the punchline, Medium for the URL and contact line.

The front QR resolves to preparematelatte.milonga.life/link. The back QR is a PLACEHOLDER pointing at /review - regenerate it against your real review destination before you print.
